Assessment.content: Localised allergic reaction to insect sting, mild, with no systemic or anaphylactic signs.
Assessment.source_text: 1. Localised allergic reaction to insect sting—mild, no systemic/anaphylactic signs

Assessment.content: Anxiety regarding possible deterioration of condition.

Plan_of_Care.content: Start over-the-counter antihistamine such as chlorphenamine 4 mg orally every 4–6 hours as needed or a once-daily alternative.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: • Start OTC antihistamine: chlorphenamine 4 mg PO q4–6 h prn or once-daily alternative

Plan_of_Care.content: Educate patient on red flags including lip or tongue swelling, stridor, worsening shortness of breath, and spreading or hot erythema, with instruction to attend A&E if these occur.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: • Educate on red flags: lip/tongue swelling, stridor, worsening SOB, spreading/hot erythema → attend A&E

Plan_of_Care.content: Provide patient with an information link on anaphylaxis.
If arm redness spreads or feels hot, consider starting an oral antibiotic and call GP.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: • If arm redness spreads/feels hot → consider oral antibiotic; call GP

Plan_of_Care.content: Monitor condition and, if recurrent stings or unexplained rashes occur, consider allergy work-up.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: • Monitor; if recurrent stings or unexplained rashes → consider allergy work-up

Plan_of_Care.content: Provide reassurance and advise a low threshold to re-contact clinician for concerns.
Plan_of_Care.source_text: • Reassurance; advised low threshold to re-contact clinician for concerns

Follow_up_Information.content: Patient advised to attend A&E if red flag symptoms such as lip or tongue swelling, stridor, worsening shortness of breath, or spreading/hot erythema occur.
Follow_up_Information.source_text: • Educate on red flags: lip/tongue swelling, stridor, worsening SOB, spreading/hot erythema → attend A&E

Follow_up_Information.content: Patient advised to call GP if arm redness spreads or feels hot to consider oral antibiotic.

Follow_up_Information.content: Patient advised to re-contact clinician with a low threshold for any concerns.
